failure_modes: Reading design into what is only aggregate statistics
Missing the mechanism that turns noise into signal
gloss: Colony-level adaptive behavior emerges from individual agents following local rules
invariants: No unit holds the global plan
mechanism: Ants act by {{local_rule}} and no ant holds the colony plan, yet the colony adapts. A mechanism must recognize signal in noise and then build on top of it. Understanding how random information starts to make sense to a collection of simple units is the open question, in biological and artificial systems alike.
